about: About the data. Chains come from the Hadith Narrators dataset on Kaggle (narrator IDs per ḥadīth, mirrored on Hugging Face as Almoooo/dataset_hadith), matched to sunnah.com numbering by their Arabic text. Names, dates, generations (ṭabaqāt, following Ibn Ḥajar's Taqrīb) and grades come from muslimscholars.info. A link between two narrators means one received a ḥadīth from the other in at least one of Muslim's chains; the number is how many ḥadīth pass through that link. Muslim often gives a ḥadīth with several chains (joined by taḥwīl); the dataset lists their names in one run, and they were separated here by starting a new chain wherever a name comes back, so some secondary chains are incomplete and some may be wrong. Names were matched automatically and may be wrong. Chains that stop at a Companion are joined to the Prophet ﷺ; those that stop at a later narrator are not.
